description.value: The Keg is a well-established Canadian steakhouse chain with this location housed in a historical building in Vancouver's downtown Financial and Entertainment District, at the corner of Dunsmuir and Granville, steps from the Skytrain station. The Dunsmuir location offers a dining room, lounge, bar, and private and semi-private dining rooms accommodating groups of various sizes. Free Wi-Fi and takeout ordering are available for those wanting a quick stop or a full sit-down meal after a ride.
